description: This file defines the 'Depreciation' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing calculations for various depreciation methods such as DB, DDB, SLN, and SYD.

classes.name: Depreciation
classes.description: Provides static methods for various depreciation calculations used in financial computations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Calculates depreciation using the fixed-declining balance method for a given period.

methods.name: DDB
methods.description: Calculates depreciation using the double-declining balance method or a custom method for a given period.

methods.name: SLN
methods.description: Calculates straight-line depreciation for a single period.

methods.name: SYD
methods.description: Calculates sum-of-years' digits depreciation for a specific period.
